nom: No7 Laboratories Line Correcting Booster Serum

avis.texte: Used two bottles of this stuff and didn't see a thing different. Not worth the money

avis.titre: I will try this product one more time.
avis.texte: I am not as pleased with this No. 7 product as I had hoped. I have gone through one container and am somewhat disappointed in the contours of my face on my forehead, and around my eyes and mouth. I will try one more container and if I do not see visible improvement, I will not buy it again. It is very expensive and I cannot afford to continue buying it if it doesn't do what it says.

avis.titre: This will always be in my daily routine!
avis.texte: I have left several reviews concerning this product….all positive. I use this daily and it feels like liquid silk being applied to my face. My skin feels soft and looks radiant. I'm 74 years old with minimal wrinkles, and I attribute this to the No.7 products that I use on a daily basis. I love their products.

Ooohh, I love this line correcting serum! I started using this back in April, adding it to my No. 7 Restore & Renew face & neck serum, and I love it. It looks like a long "test tube" and the contents come out when you push the bottom "button". At first I thought it doesn't give you very much to cover your face, but after dotting it on my face, I was surprised at how well it covers the area. I do use 2 "shots" of it to cover both my face and my neck. It goes on smoothly and yes, it does soften those stubborn lines and wrinkles. I love pairing these two serums together.

This was OK … used the entire product over the course of ab a month and only had minimal results. The skin was much mor hydrated, but deep wrinkles were still there… small lines around the eyes were slightly improved, but there are so many better products out there that function in the same way. (Let me put you on to the LANEIGE bouncy & firm serum)

avis.titre: My second purchase of this item, but not my last.
avis.texte: I first purchased this item back in April. I had never used No. 7 before, so I opted to try this particular item. I am so glad I did….it is wonderful. It goes on like silk, feels so smooth, and leaves your face feeling refreshed and uplifted. It's hard to explain, but I see a definite difference in my face after applying this product. It looks like a long syringe, and at the bottom there is a "knob" you turn to dispense. It produces just the right amount you'll need for one side of your face. A little goes a long way. My second purchase was the first week of July. I will definitely continue using this product.

It completely took my lines away between my eye from squinting so much. Helped my forehead and under eyes. However, it did not help my smile lines on the side if my eyes. They are pretty deep already. Amazing product and I use it every single day!
DR/ PHIL HAD A PRESENTATION ABOUTTHIS PRODUCT, SAID IF YOU USE THIS, YOU WON'T NEED PLASTIC SURGERY - VERY TRUE

I've only been using this serum for close to 2 weeks, and so far I am very impressed with it. For starters, a little goes a long way. I use it primarily around my smile and marionette lines. I can see a softening of these lines. They are deep, so I'm not expecting a miracle here, but to see any kind of an improvement is encouraging. Hopefully after a couple of months of use, I'll see even more improvement. I will purchase this product again, as I feel you should give a new product enough time to truly see results.

avis.titre: I always will buy this product
avis.texte: I will not use my other skin care. This product works miracles on my lines.
I use this every single day to reduce lines in the sensitive area under my eyes

I used this product for several months before writing this review. I like the smoothness and silkiness of the serum. its has a nice consistency that easily glides over the skin and absorbs well. I think it may reduce the appearance if small wrinkles but I did not see it dimmish the appearance of my one deep wrinkle in the middle of the forehead. I like the product though, I just cant give it 5 stars for that. This review is based off a complimentary sample I received.

I have been using this product for 3 years now and makes my face smooth, clear, and soft to touch. It also helps soften the small lines around my forehead. I have a dry & very sensitive skin so there's not a lot of product that I can use. But This No 7 Line Correcting Booster Serum really work. I am glad I found this product!
I used this product everyday. It did seem to smooth out lines somewhat with regular use. I would definitely try this longer and buy another bottle to see if I notice more of a difference.

avis.titre: Definitely Does Makes A Huge Difference
avis.texte: I wasn't certain if it was possible to address the fine lines and areas as promised and I was most concerned with. I have used twelve weeks and can't believe the amazing results! Ordering more and definitely a believer now! I would recommend it to you!

avis.titre: This is by far my new favorite beauty product!!!
avis.texte: Love how it feels on ur skin and pretty sure I can see improvements!!! I use it as part of my night time and morning routine faithfully....oh and let's not forget to mention the packaging it's very stunning def falls into the high end look except at a smaller price!!!

I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review. First, the concept of this product is super cool- I like what it claims to do. The product itself comes packaged nicely and application is also easy with no wasted product. I have used morning and night for the last 6 weeks and still have over half the product left. It did not irritate my sensitive 43 yr old skin. I love No 7 products and generally think everything I have tried is good quality. The results? I don't seem to notice much of a change w any of my fine lines, however they aren't super pronounced to begin with. I would recommend the product to someone else to try out and plan to keep using it in my skincare routine and keep monitoring for any improvements!

I love the texture of this product. It rubbed in nicely and left my skin feeling silky and moisturized. After just a month I have noticed my face looks more plump. I'll keep using to see how my fine lines fade.
This is a very nice product. It smells great and feels luxurious. I can't really tell if it is correcting any of my lines though.
I used this product in the morning and in the evening. It was easy to use, it was not oily or greasy and went well under makeup.

I really do love this product. I can already see improvements in my fine lines within a few weeks! I'm really happy because this is the first product that I have tried that actually seems to work for my fine lines. I have mostly noticed a difference in the lines on the bridge of my nose. This is not a miracle product and my lines are still there but they're much less noticeable!! I'm excited to see what continued use will do for me! I would definitely recommend to family & friends and will definitely continue using this for a long time.

I applied it in the morning and at night underwear and around my eyes also on my forehead and wherever I had fine lines. It helped my skin Stas smooth feel fresh and wore it under makeup too. I started seeing results the first day believe it or not. I would recommend this product definitely. I appreciate this bzz reviews you and No7 have helped my confidence!

avis.titre: I use this for lines on chest
avis.texte: I received this sample as part of the BZZ Agent sampling program. I have been using this consistently everyday for about 3 weeks now. I apply on my crows feet and the unsightly lines on my chest from sun damage. I have noticed an improvement in the crows feet but I am really impressed with the diminished prominence in the fine lines on my chest! No other product has given me these results in such a short time. Overall the appearance of the lines has decreased and when I apply some body oil Over the top They look remarkably improved! I am so pleased I was able to try this product and would recommend you try as well.

I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion; I am truly impressed! A small amount of serum goes a long way. My fine lines are virtually invisible, and my worry lines appear less harsh. I feel that this serum is a great value and is definitely worth a shot.

avis.titre: I would purchase this product. It was effective.
avis.texte: I used the serum under my regular moisturizer, then applied foundation. After several weeks I did notice that the fine lines under my eyes were less noticeable. The product was odorless, which I liked and felt smooth going on. I also liked the convenient applicator.
Use this product under my eyes and around my lips. Have noticed a remarkable improvement. The applicatoe makes it so easy to apply and no waste from taking too much product out.
I love the sleek look of the packaging, the product didn't feel greasy or tacky. After using for a few weeks I did notice lines diminishing and will continue to use this

I used the No 7 Line Correcting Serum every morning and before I go to bed. The results are amazing because this Serum reduced all my deep lines. I'm so excited because I'm looking younger and the change it's unbelievable. From now on I'm going to used this Serum . Thank you BzzAgent Sampling Community for choosing me to try this magic Serum.

I saw some noticeable results after using this for 3 weeks! I'm in my 60's, I have lines and wrinkles. I don't expect miracles, lol. I simply want to look good for my age. I am just recovering from an illness and my skin definitely needed a boost! I use this as an added step in my skincare routine along with my other products to "boost" their effectiveness. This product has a silky feel to it, very light, but don't let that fool you! This stuff packs a powerful punch of line smoothing product targeted directly to the lines and wrinkles. You just apply the booster, pat into your skin and let it absorb. My lines became less deep with continued use, and that is huge! I would absolutely continue to buy this 100% and I will recommend it as well. This is the best product from the No. 7 brand that I have ever tried. I received this product on a complimentary basis in exchange for my honest review.
I used it as directed and didn't notice much results in said time.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I used this product for 4 weeks before I wrote my review and I can tell you this stuff realy works! For being a retinol cream, it is gentle, yet effective. I never had any of the redness or peeling I have experienxed with some retinol creams. After 4 weeks, I noticed a good reduction in the fine lines and texture around my eyes, forehead, and smile lines. This stuff works! Give it time and trust the process!

I use the product by pumping twice so that's enough to put around my face. I use both hands to smooth around because I have small wrinkles already at 40. It's been a few weeks I've been using this and I have seen minimize results. The product specifications say I will see results in 12 weeks. So I can't wait to see the full maximum results. The product is smooth and will soak into pores if there open. I use the product right away after a shower. In the morning I shower again and use it right away. It's working so far and I do recommend this product.
Made my skin soft I sawll a little improvement i think with more time and product it would get there. Have to use every day to see results so have to stay committed. No smell or didn't dry out skin

I received this product as part of a sampling campaign for free. What I liked most about the product is the texture. It's almost silk-like. It also feels very light as it absorbs into your skin. It was hard for me to tell just how much it helped my wrinkles, but they did look to improve over the 3-4 weeks that I've been using the product.
I am a 57yrs old woman and my face is showing its age and I find that it does help with the fine lines in my face . I can see a difference in my lines . It is drastic but you can tell .

avis.titre: No7 Line Correcting Booster Serum Works Wonders on Wrinkles
avis.texte: I've been using the No7 Laboratories Line Correcting Booster Serum for a couple of weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed. What I love most about this serum is its versatility. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it easy to incorporate into my skincare routine. I use it before my moisturizer, but you can also mix a drop or two into your moisturizer or foundation for an added boost. By the second week, I saw improvements in other areas like my lip lines and under my eyes. No7 has really outdone themselves with this one. This serum is a fantastic addition to their lineup, offering a high-quality, effective solution for reducing wrinkles without breaking the bank.
I don't find this serum to be effective on fine lines and wrinkles. I haven't noticed a difference at all.
I would definitely recommend this product to everyone. I could actually tell a difference at the end of the first week
After three weeks of use, I have started to see some minor results. I am hopeful that I will see more obvious results overtime. Product is easy to use, has a pleasant smell, and does not burn.

avis.titre: Good for my 42 year old face!
avis.texte: I really enjoy using this serum along with my acne treatments at night. Right before I moisturize, I apply to the target lines around my eyes and mouth. I have been using it for over a month, and I'm really starting to see a more even and smooth complexion.

avis.titre: I will repurchase this product again!
avis.texte: I have been using this product 2x a day for over a month. I received this product free through a campaign and am required to leave a review. I will be reordering when this tube is finished! I love the tub also - how you can easily dispense a small amount.
Works great! I was very impressed with the results I can see after using only a couple weeks. My skin is noticeably better and smoother.

avis.titre: Not a bad serum.   Seemed to work somewhat
avis.texte: Used this product every morning on clean dry bare skin and every night on clean dry bare skin. Seemed to work better some days than others.

avis.titre: This middle age mom will be buying again!
avis.texte: I received No 7 Line Boosting Serum as part of a BzzAgent no cost campaign in exchange for my honest opinion after trying this product. I have used a super serum by a competitor brand for the last 10 years. However, after trying No 7 Serum for a few weeks I am switching permanently. It leaves my skin feeling smoother without the sticky residue some serums can leave behind. The dry patches on my cheeks have all but disappeared! It also leaves it feeling soft to the touch. I have noticed that my under eye concealer does not crack and look cakey by the end of the day. I have noticeably fewer wrinkles on my forehead as well. I will definitely be buying this product in the future and telling all of my friends they need it in their skincare routine! It's FANTASTIC!

avis.titre: Excellent Line Softener where you need it most
avis.texte: I use the product in the morning after I wash my face. I put the product directly in the lines and wrinkles that concern me. I wait for the product to dry and then I continue with my regular skin care routine. I repeat this regimen in the evening before bed.

I use this product twice daily on my fine lines around my eyes and straight across my forehead. It helps reduce the appearance of lines and provides a much smoother look. I love how easy it is to use and the smoothing effects. This is an excellent product which provides a nice smooth look. n

The No.7 Line Correcting Booster Serum is a game-changer in the world of skincare. Its innovative formula delivers noticeable results, visibly reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. It visibly reduces deep lines and wrinkles in 1 week. It is suitable for sensitive skin. I started seeing very noticeable results with consistent use over 2 weeks. This is a must-have in your skincare regimen.
Enjoyed this product. Ts gentle and did not irritate my skin. Nice and smooth and blend in very well. I received this product for free to try/test and review.
I would buy again! Softens line but you must use it consistently to see real results.

I received this product free to sample in exchange for my honest review-opinions are 100% my own. I have heard great things about the No7 brand but this is the first product I've tried. I really like the packaging-i think it's clever that it looks like a syringe. The packaging also keeps the product fresh and avoids contamination-and helps to apply precisely to areas like 11 and laugh lines. 11 lines are something that I've been bothered by for a few years now. I've tried a number of different serums and moisturizers and none have really made a noticeable difference-until I tried the No7 Line Correcting Booster Serum. This serum has really helped soften my 11's. I like how this serum is thick and stays put on the problem areas I'm trying to focus on. I plan on continuing using this serum and look forward to continuing improvement of my 11's and recommend this serum to anyone else dealing with the same issue.

I love this product because it has given life to my skin, not only it has helped with my wrinkles but my skin looks a lot more hydrated and it feels smooth and soft , I will totally use this more often and recommend it to all of my friends and family.

I was SUPER excited to use this serum because I was convinced that I will see results. So I used it every single day, sometimes twice a day. I did this for 4 weeks and didn't see any difference at all. I am going to keep using it cause I've heard good things about it. But I can't tell you how discouraging it is to not see any difference after all this time of use.

I received this N7 line correcting booster serum and have been using it for about 3 weeks now , I have noticed how the fine lines on my forehead and around my mouth have diminished , the formula is lightweight and fast absorbing , I have combination skin and haven't had any issues with this formula as with others I tried before that tend to leave my skin feeling dry .

I really loved this product. I thnk it works as great as the expensive brands. It does take time and the line reduction is a slow process but the difference is noticeable. I also love how it works on my skin to moisturize and smooth it out. The ease of use is fantastic, nothing goes to waste, no smell.

I started using this serum couple weeks ago around my eyes and I've noticed the they're less noticeable . I also noticed that my skin around my eyes is a lot firmer. I do notice a glow looks a lot brightened around my eyes. I really like the packaging it makes it easier for packing away when I'm taking a trip ,I don't have to worry about it breaking or spilling. When applying the application I like the little ball on the tip makes it easier to target my lines. I'm impressed how affordable it is I will definitely continue to use.

This product is amazing. It really does help with the fine lines and wrinkles. It's a great anti-aging tool if you are not ready to go to the fillers and the Botox and all the other stuff at this time in your life.
I didn't notice any difference after using it twice daily for the 28 days. I like the texture, but didn't think I'd pay that price without results.

I'm so glad No7 gifted me this Line Correcting Booster Serum to try out. I've used it morning and night for over 4 weeks. The applicator dispenses a nice amount with an easy push button. I don't feel like I'm wasting any product. A little goes a long way and after 4 weeks, I'm not quite half way through the tube. The formula is quite smooth and soaks in quickly. There is no smell which I'm glad about. While my deep lines around my mouth had minimal improvement, my forehead lines and smaller wrinkles lessened. My favorite result is that my overall skin texture has dramatically improved. I know it can't be, but I swear it seems like my skin is lifted.

I am really enjoying using this serum - the packaging is excellent. The texture is smooth and moisturizing and I am noticing some lines fading away! Time will tell. It's great to see this British Skincare brand available in more stores stateside.

avis.titre: Permanent part of my skincare routine
avis.texte: I have used many different types of creams to soften my lines and wrinkles - from drug store brands to expensive Korean brands. No7 Line Correcting Booster Serum works just as well, if not better than the expensive brands. The packaging is well thought out so no serum goes to waste. There is no fragrance to note. You can use it alone for targeted treatment or mix it in with other products to save time. I used it both ways and saw noticable results both ways. Bottom line, this serum delivers results and is now a permanent part of my skincare routine.

I was thrilled to receive a free sample of No. 7 Serum. My skin had been uneven and dry, fine lines were exacerbated by dehydration, and I needed help. After using twice a day, I saw noticeable changes even within the first two weeks. My skin was moisturized, my make-up applied more evenly and floated on top of my skin instead of sinking in like a sponge. I really like the feel and the way No. 7 absorbs easily and effectively. You must try it!!
I apply after washing my face at night. doesnt need much so it lasts a long time.

avis.titre: A thick serum, too heavy for me.
avis.texte: I used the product as a spot treatment for fine lines and wrinkles. I applied it morning and night for 4 weeks, and found that my skin seemed to be more oily than usual, and it often would leach into my eyes if applied too closely or above my eyebrows. It was a thick serum and felt heavy on my skin, not absorbing well. I could feel it wash off after wearing overnight or at the end of the day. I did notice some improvements in find lines over the first week, but deeper wrinkles didn't seem much affected. I personally didn't like the heavy feel, but some people may find that to be a luxurious feel.

This product works! I received the N0. 7 line correcting booster serum to try at no cost. I AM GIVING MY HONEST REVIEW! I am posting before and after pictures. I used it 2 times a day around my eyes for approximately 4 weeks. (I missed a few PM applications) are my fine lines 100% gone? NO. But many have vanished! I have always been a fan of No. 7 products and this will be added to my list of favorites!

avis.titre: Finally a product that really works!!
avis.texte: I absolutely loved this product! Is like nothing I've ever used before, you can see results within a few weeks, it's doesn't have a scent, the applicator makes it easy to apply without being messy, you have to be consistent and use morning AND night, it absorbs beautifully on skin and it's not tacky or sticky. I will continue to use around my mouth, I think I need more time with those deep lines, but I definitely noticed a huge difference on my forehead and around my eyes, I'm so excited !

I wanted to love this so much!! The packaging is so cute, like a syringe. It goes on smoothly when you apply it but it has a greasy feel. It seemed like it sat on the top of my skin leaving a noticeable shine. I used it for over 3-4 weeks and I didn't really notice a difference. I'm assuming it dries that way to hold in moisture with a physical barrier but I don't want that on my face. I will continue to use it on my hands, but I probably won't buy it again.

I've been used the Line Correcting Booster Serum for a few weeks and I don't see much of a difference. It's important to note that at 50 years old thankfully I have minimal lines on my face to begin with other than smile lines. I will continue to use the product to the end and re-evaluate to determine if I will re-purchase.

avis.titre: My new favorite skin care routine
avis.texte: I love this new line correcting booster my number seven. It's my new favorite Skin care routine my face feels so much better. The lines are fading and it's not greasy. I will continue to buy this and use this every day and every night. Thank you for the free sample.

I'm 57 and have both fine lines and wrinkles. I was recently gifted this lovely Line Correcting Booster by @No7 and @BzzAgents for my honest opinion. The bottle itself is very sleek and stylish. I used the serum at night after cleansing my face. There's no scent, so I liked and appreciated that:. The fine lines in the corners of my eyes have definitely started to diminish. I highly recommend this or any other No7 product.
Lightweight, smooth application that leaves skin feeling smooth and hydrated. Used 2x per day and saw fine lines begin to diminish!

This No7 Line Correcting Booster Serum works to help minimize any lines and wrinkles but from my experience this product did not work as expected. I did not see a difference on my fine lines nor where they much less pronounced. I saw no change in the time that I used it. I applied it at least once daily around the fine lines by my eyes where I do have the most wrinkles, my mouth area where I also have some signs of aging, and the deeper lines on my forehead. The serum itself has no scent and did not irritate my skin. I will continue to use the product until it is all gone but I wont get my hopes up. The days I didnt use the serum I noticed my wrinkles seemed to be a little more pronounced than ever which I definitely did not like. I will say that I did like how soft and moisturizing the serum felt on my skin. The bottle is nicely designed, however there is a lot of product left behind in the bottle once the product stops coming out. I received this product as part of a free sample program.

The No.7 Line Correcting Booster Serum is a game-changer in the world of skincare. Its innovative formula delivers noticeable results, visibly reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. With consistent use, this serum enhances skin texture, leaving it smoother and more radiant. The lightweight, non-greasy texture makes it a joy to apply, sinking effortlessly into the skin. Say hello to a more youthful-looking complexion with the No.7 Line Correcting Booster Serum – your secret weapon for ageless beauty.

avis.titre: Give it a try and see for yourself!
avis.texte: received this product as part of a free sample program. This magical Serum comes in a bottle looking like a syringe. I guess it's a hint that it will actually does it's job well, and it does. I have tried it for a month now, in the mornings and evenings, and I focused on the lines between my eyebrows and those irritating lines around the lips. I'm a senior and need some help with stubborn lines like that. Did it work? After a month the lines and wrinkles are still there, but a bit less visible. I do think that if I continue using Line Correcting Booster Serum I will get an even more visible result, it's just that I haven't used it long enough. Yet. Will I buy it and keep using it? I will. And if you think the price is a bit high, think again. It's quality, and your skin will love it. The Serum is so smooth, so easy to apply and my skin sort of behave like a thirsty sponge to it: it sinks in immediately and it does it job well. I am superhappy to have got the opportunity to have tried this Serum. I thought it was enough with my usual day-and nightcreams, but my wrinkles and lines needed a good quality Serum. For a reasonable price.

I received this line booster serum from NO 7 Laboratories in exchange for my honest review, and while it's by no means Botox in a bottle l've seen some softening my fine lines and wrinkles. I found the packaging to be a bit gimmicky and unnecessary, as it's merely aesthetic and not at all functionally smart. The syringe-looking applicator locks and unlocks at the bottom, and with the push of a button the serum shoots out, so I found it best to put it in my fingertips first or mix into my moisturizer. The product itself felt great, absorbed quickly and didn't irritate my skin. However, I had to resort to nighttime only application as this serum formula didn't play nicely with my makeup products. Nonetheless, after 3 weeks of nightly usage l've noticed a reduction in the appearance of my nasolabial wrinkles.
Great product does what it claims non drying and very light wieght

avis.titre: I like the noticeable results in a short time of use.
avis.texte: I used this product morning and night after washing my face. It can be used alone or with moisturizers and makeup. I've noticed lines on my forehead and upper lip aren't as noticeable now. I'm starting to see an improvement around my eyes as well. I've used it for 2 1/2 weeks so far. A little goes a long way so the product will last long. It doesn't leave skin feeling oily. You can see in my photo the bottom of the container the amount I've used so far. It goes on smooth and my skin has never been so soft as after using it. I will definitely recommend to family and friends.
I loved using this product at night as part of my night time routine. It was easy and I saw results after a couple of weeks

I love this line correction serum ! I was shocked and honestly just amazed with the progress this has made to the wrinkles on my face , Its really stressful trying to get rid of those dang lines ! I was using retinol but thats bad to wear during the day and can be bad to wear during the day ! Thanks so much number 7

I received a complimentary product in exchange for providing an honest review. I am 42 years old and I have been using Botox for the last 3-4 years, mainly in my forehead. I was skeptical about the line correcting booster serum, as I haven't had much success with products claiming to help fine lines and wrinkles. This product was incredible! I used it as directed, morning and night, for 28 days. I started noticing the smile lines around my eyes faded around 3 weeks. I also used this product on my nasal labial folds around my mouth and noticed a considerable difference in the static lines that remain AFTER smiling. I would absolutely purchase this product moving forward. This product was a very pleasant surprise!

avis.titre: I would continue to use this product.
avis.texte: Anyone with forehead lines and crows feet will like this. I also used some above my upper lip for those fine lines.

avis.titre: I need to buy this now, i don't want to run out!
avis.texte: I use two drops AM/PM on a clean face-one drop to the eyes and one drop to my smile lines. I started off using three drops but I just wasted Product. Two little drops easily get the job done. Your skin is instantly more alive and hydrated. The lines are going away!!! I am shocked. The package is so well made no air will get into this! I love I can leave it uncapped and not worry. It also doesn't take up too much space. The slim design is nice. I will keep buying this and now look at more choices from this brand!!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I'm always up to try new skincare. Very impressed with this! It did soften my line, but key is..use like directions say.

I received as part of a free sample Line Correcting Booster Serum No7 thank you BzzAgwnt. I began to see the firmness after applying everyday for a couple of weeks. It is lightweight which feels soft on your face. I watched the lines reduce to make me look younger. I would buy this product and recommend it to family and friends.

avis.titre: Product got smaller and prize increase
avis.texte: I normally would give this No7 Line Correcting Serum a 5 star since I used this No7 Line Correcting Serum consistently for couple years. But disappointed when I bought it recently and No 7 change the packaging of the product- made it smaller than before with price increase. I am going to find another antiaging serum because No7 change it to smaller packaging and increased the price.

I only used No7 now for 4yrs for all my facial care and it has been effective. I have been using this product from No7 for over 1 year now and I love it. I used it day and night and definitely see the change and soften my wrinkles in between my forehead. I highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: I have consistently continued to purchase this product .
avis.texte: Love this product and have been buying this since it was first put on the market. Would highly recommend.
One week using this product and the lines aren't as deep. Looking forward to results after week two!

This works! I'm always being skeptical when it comes to anything anti-wrinkle. I'm post-menopausal, 47yrs, with dry and sensitive skin due to Lupus and medications. I use sunblock and avoid direct sunlight. I use it on my upper lip lines and very deep forhead lines. Only at night! (I'm very careful about this type of product and sun exposure). Saw results on the first 5 days! My lip lines were softer, not gone. I even noticed that my upper lip got a bit plump. After 4 weeks, upper lip lines are very soft, lip still look plump. Forhead lines are softer now, less deep. That vertical one between the eye has diminished as well. I mean, I had to leave a review.

The first 3 ingredients of this "serum" are Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Aluminium Starch Octenylsuccinate. So water, a solvent, and an anti-caking agent. WAYYY overpriced for absolutely nothing
Only started using 5 days ago but it hasn't broken my skin out nor made it any oilier. Have been using on my forehead and around mouth so I am hoping for good things!
I was weary bc I have deep lines. It works well. It seems like fine lines decrease and fills in deeper lines. Recommend!!
I found that this product does help with lines. I use for the lines between my eyes, and I believe that it has improved them. I am looking forward to trying No. 7's new booster serum.
